🔥 The energy price cap rose 4% on 1 October - from £1,663 to £1,723 a year for a typical household. That's £60 more, just as the heating goes on.

Ofgem's own words: "High international gas prices are continuing to drive energy costs in the UK."

Britain should be using its own North Sea gas, not paying whatever the world market demands. 👇
